# 1. Environment Setup
```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)
library(qiime2R)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(vegan)
library(writexl)
library(ANCOMBC)
library(TreeSummarizedExperiment)
library(S4Vectors)

# Set working directory to project root
setwd("~/Escritorio/R/2026_COPROFAGIA/coprofagia/cutadapt_comparison")

# Ensure output directory exists
output_dir <- "sensitivity_analysis_outputs"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

# 2. Import Trimmed QIIME 2 Artifacts (Cutadapt Preprocessing Sensitivity)
```{r}
# Load feature table, taxonomy, tree, and metadata for the explicit cutadapt-trimmed workflow
physeq_trimmed <- qza_to_phyloseq(
  features = "filtered-table-genus-trimmed.qza",
  tree = "tree-trimmed/rooted_tree.qza",
  taxonomy = "taxa-trimmed.qza",
  metadata = "metadata.tsv"
)

# Remove Archaea and Eukaryota
physeq_trimmed_clean <- subset_taxa(physeq_trimmed, Kingdom != "d__Archaea")
physeq_trimmed_clean <- subset_taxa(physeq_trimmed_clean, Kingdom != "d__Eukaryota")

# Enforce cohort factor ordering: CON -> SCP -> CP
sample_data(physeq_trimmed_clean)$group <- factor(
  sample_data(physeq_trimmed_clean)$group, 
  levels = c("CON", "SCP", "CP")
)

physeq_trimmed_clean
```

# 3. Compute Diversity Metrics and PERMANOVA for Sensitivity Report
```{r}
# 1. Alpha Diversity Calculation (Observed, Chao1, Shannon)
alpha_trim_df <- estimate_richness(physeq_trimmed_clean, measures = c("Observed", "Chao1", "Shannon"))
alpha_trim_df$SampleID <- rownames(alpha_trim_df)
alpha_trim_df <- merge(alpha_trim_df, data.frame(sample_data(physeq_trimmed_clean)), by.x = "SampleID", by.y = "row.names")

# Save individual CSV
write.csv(alpha_trim_df, file.path(output_dir, "Alpha_Diversity_Trimmed_Sensitivity.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# 2. Beta Diversity Matrices (Bray-Curtis & Unweighted UniFrac)
otu_trimmed_mat <- as(otu_table(physeq_trimmed_clean), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(physeq_trimmed_clean)) { otu_trimmed_mat <- t(otu_trimmed_mat) }

bc_trim_dist <- vegdist(t(otu_trimmed_mat), method = "bray")
uw_trim_dist <- UniFrac(physeq_trimmed_clean, weighted = FALSE, normalized = TRUE)

# 3. PERMANOVA Evaluation
metadata_trim <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_trimmed_clean))
permanova_bc_trim <- adonis2(bc_trim_dist ~ group, data = metadata_trim, permutations = 1000)
permanova_uw_trim <- adonis2(uw_trim_dist ~ group, data = metadata_trim, permutations = 1000)

# Export text logs
capture.output(permanova_bc_trim, file = file.path(output_dir, "PERMANOVA_BrayCurtis_Trimmed.txt"))
capture.output(permanova_uw_trim, file = file.path(output_dir, "PERMANOVA_UnweightedUniFrac_Trimmed.txt"))
```

# 4. Compositionally Aware Differential Abundance (ANCOM-BC2) on Trimmed Data
```{r}
# 1. Agglomerate trimmed counts at Family level
physeq_fam_trim <- tax_glom(physeq_trimmed_clean, taxrank = "Family")

# 2. Extract counts and taxonomy
counts_trim <- as(physeq_fam_trim@otu_table, "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(physeq_fam_trim)) { counts_trim <- t(counts_trim) }

tax_trim_mat <- as(physeq_fam_trim@tax_table, "matrix")
fam_trim_names <- as.character(tax_trim_mat[, "Family"])
fam_trim_names[is.na(fam_trim_names) | fam_trim_names == ""] <- "Unclassified_Family"
rownames(counts_trim) <- make.unique(fam_trim_names)

# 3. Metadata setup
meta_trim_df <- data.frame(
  group = as.character(physeq_fam_trim@sam_data$group),
  row.names = rownames(physeq_fam_trim@sam_data),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
meta_trim_df$group <- factor(meta_trim_df$group, levels = c("CON", "SCP", "CP"))

# 4. TreeSummarizedExperiment & ANCOM-BC2 execution
tse_trim <- TreeSummarizedExperiment(
  assays = list(counts = counts_trim),
  colData = S4Vectors::DataFrame(meta_trim_df)
)

set.seed(123)
ancom_trim_out <- ancombc2(
  data = tse_trim,
  assay_name = "counts",
  tax_level = NULL,
  fix_formula = "group",
  p_adj_method = "BH",
  prv_cut = 0.10,
  group = "group",
  struc_zero = TRUE,
  neg_lb = TRUE,
  pairwise = TRUE,
  verbose = FALSE
)

res_ancom_trim <- ancom_trim_out$res_pair
write.csv(res_ancom_trim, file.path(output_dir, "ANCOMBC2_Trimmed_Preprocessing_Results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# 5. Compile and Export Multi-Sheet Workbook as Supplementary Data S1
```{r}
# Read generated files safely for the Excel workbook
df_alpha_trim <- tryCatch({
  read.csv(file.path(output_dir, "Alpha_Diversity_Trimmed_Sensitivity.csv"))
}, error = function(e) { data.frame(Note = "Alpha diversity data unavailable") })

permanova_bc_file <- file.path(output_dir, "PERMANOVA_BrayCurtis_Trimmed.txt")
df_permanova_summary <- if (file.exists(permanova_bc_file)) {
  data.frame(Results_Summary = readLines(permanova_bc_file))
} else {
  data.frame(Results_Summary = "PERMANOVA Bray-Curtis text summary not found.")
}

df_ancom_trim <- tryCatch({
  read.csv(file.path(output_dir, "ANCOMBC2_Trimmed_Preprocessing_Results.csv"))
}, error = function(e) { data.frame(Note = "ANCOM-BC2 results unavailable") })

# Create the named list for Excel sheets
supplementary_s1_workbook <- list(
  "Preprocessing_Stats" = df_alpha_trim,
  "PERMANOVA_Summary"   = df_permanova_summary,
  "ANCOMBC2_Pairwise"   = df_ancom_trim
)

# Export workbook
output_filename <- "Supplementary Data S1. Preprocessing Sensitivity Analysis.xlsx"
write_xlsx(supplementary_s1_workbook, path = output_filename)

cat("Successfully compiled and generated multi-sheet workbook:", output_filename, "\n")
```
